description: This source file defines internal static class ConsistentRingInstruments responsible for registering observable gauge metrics related to consistent ring size and percentages in the Orleans runtime. It uses the System.Diagnostics.Metrics namespace for instrumentation and maintains static gauge instances with registration methods.

classes.name: ConsistentRingInstruments
classes.description: Internal static class for managing metrics instrumentation related to consistent ring size and percentage metrics.

methods.name: RegisterRingSizeObserve
methods.description: Registers an observable gauge for the ring size metric with a provided observation function.

methods.name: RegisterMyRangeRingPercentageObserve
methods.description: Registers an observable gauge for the local size percentage of the ring with a provided observation function.

methods.name: RegisterAverageRingPercentageObserve
methods.description: Registers an observable gauge for the average size percentage of the ring with a provided observation function.
